mapper.sql:
SELECT user_id, dept_id, user_name, nick_name, user_type, email, phone, sex, avatar, password, status, login_ip, login_date,create_time FROM sys_user
AND user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.userName}, '%')
AND nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.nickName}, '%')
AND phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{param.phone}, '%')
AND status = #{param.status}
AND dept_id = #{param.deptId}
AND del_flag = '0'
ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, dept_id, user_name, nick_name, user_type, email, phone, sex, avatar, password, status, login_ip, login_date,create_time FROM sys_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0'
